title: Bismuth recurring at S4
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Bismuth recurring at S4, about 1988-1989 at S4, Nevada, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There's a reason why Bob Lazar kept hearing about it at S4. [music]
take one like bismouth I think which I think comes up a lot in sort of UFO lore
tellings.difference: Speaks of UFO lore in general and does not name S4.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of bismuth recurring in UFO lore through Bob Lazar and S4.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that bismuth, a heavy metal, keeps coming up in UFO stories. He says there is a reason Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in the late 1980s at S4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, kept hearing about it there. In another episode Michels just calls it a common theme in UFO lore and does not mention S4. If true, it would suggest bismuth plays some real part in how these craft work.
